AnalyzeChestVessel.title: Aortic Aneurysm and Pulmonary Hypertension Detection
AnalyzeChestVessel.description:
## Service Notice  
Due to product adjustments, the aortic aneurysm and pulmonary hypertension detection service will be migrated to DAMO Academy’s [Dayi Zhiying official website](https://damomed.com). Starting from November 26, 2025, new users will no longer be able to activate or invoke this service. Existing users who have previously activated the service may continue to use it. On November 26, 2026, the service will be delisted and will no longer support invocation by either new or existing users via the Visual Intelligence API. If you have questions regarding this migration, please visit DAMO Academy’s [Dayi Zhiying official website](https://damomed.com) to contact the relevant personnel.

## Feature Description  
The aortic aneurysm and pulmonary hypertension detection capability segments the aorta and pulmonary arteries from the input non-contrast chest CT DICOM images. It extracts the centerlines of these vessels and generates optimal-view Stretch CPR images, Cross Section images, and Straightened CPR images that wrap around the vessel circumference. Additionally, it returns the maximum diameter of each vessel, the cross-sectional area perpendicular to the vessel at every 1 mm interval along the centerline, and the coordinates of these points in the patient coordinate system of the original image.

> - You can obtain live assistance through [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- For inquiries related to API integration, usage, or technical issues with Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform capabilities, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Input Restrictions  
- Supported image formats: DICOM and NIFTI.  
- For DICOM inputs, each request must contain a minimum of 20 frames and a maximum of 600 frames.  
- For NIFTI inputs, each request must contain exactly one data instance.  
- URLs must not contain Chinese characters.

## Invocation Steps  
This capability is asynchronous and requires two steps to complete:  
1. Invoke the AnalyzeChestVessel API to submit a job. Upon successful submission, you will receive a job ID.  
2. Use the job ID to invoke the [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~) API to query the job execution status and result. If the job is still being processed, wait for some time before querying again. Avoid resubmitting the same job while it is still in progress.

## Billing Information  
The aortic aneurysm and pulmonary hypertension detection capability is currently in public preview and can be invoked free of charge.

We recommend using a software development kit (SDK) to invoke the aortic aneurysm and pulmonary hypertension detection capability under the Image Analysis and Processing category of Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API. The SDK supports multiple programming languages. When invoking this capability, select the SDK package for the AI category "imageprocess" (Image Analysis and Processing). DetectLiverSteatosis.description:
## Feature Description  
The fatty liver detection algorithm performs liver and spleen localization and segmentation based on input chest or abdominal CT images, and conducts global or local density statistical measurements of the liver and spleen. Based on these measurements and a deep learning model, it determines whether fatty liver is present and assesses its severity.

Due to product business adjustments, the Medical AI Chat service will be migrated to DAMO Academy's [Dayi Zhiying official website](https://damomed.com). Starting from November 26, 2025, new users will no longer be able to activate or invoke this service. Existing users who have previously activated the service may continue to use it. If you have any questions regarding this migration, please visit DAMO Academy's [Dayi Zhiying official website](https://damomed.com) to contact the relevant personnel.

## Feature Description  
The Medical AI Chat capability targets pre-diagnosis scenarios for skin diseases. It collects pre-diagnosis information related to skin conditions through multi-turn conversations and image collection, then outputs a structured pre-diagnosis report and predicts potential skin diseases. The collected diagnostic information primarily includes the following:

- Basic information, such as chief complaint, age, and affected body part.  
- Condition details, such as symptoms, complications, and disease duration.  
- Medical history, including past illnesses, medication history, and allergy history.  
- Unstructured information, such as skin lesion images.

> - You can access [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2) to receive live human assistance.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, interface usage, or other issues related to Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API’s visual AI capabilities, please join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Common Scenarios  
This service is designed for pre-diagnosis scenarios of skin diseases, using multi-turn conversations to collect diagnostic information.

## Key Advantages  
- The session flow is concise and intelligent, making it easy to integrate into user applications.  
- The diagnostic information extraction capability is accurate and efficient. Combined with multimodal skin disease prediction technology, it automatically generates medical case reports and potential disease diagnoses, effectively reducing the time cost of diagnosis.

## Input Restrictions  

- Image formats: JPEG, JPG, PNG, BMP.  
- Image size: No larger than 3 MB.  
- Image resolution: Greater than 256 × 256 pixels and less than 2048 × 2048 pixels.  
- URLs must not contain Chinese characters.  
- Question content must not exceed 500 characters.

## Service Notice  
Due to product business adjustments, the colorectal cancer detection service will be migrated to DAMO Academy's [Dayi Zhiying official website](https://damomed.com). ## Feature Description  
This feature takes non-contrast CT scans covering the colorectum as input—for example, chest non-contrast CT or abdominal non-contrast CT—and detects colorectal cancer (CRC). Specifically, it provides:

- A diagnostic result: either "colorectal cancer" or "healthy."
- The volume of each of the above categories, along with their corresponding areas (identified in NIfTI files).
- The probability for each of the above categories.

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).

## Invocation Steps  
This capability is asynchronous and requires the following steps:

1. Invoke the ScreenCRC API to submit a job. Upon a successful request, you will receive a job ID.
2. Invoke the [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~) API to query the result using the job ID, which returns the task execution status and result. ScreenChestCT.title: Chest CT Non-contrast Screening
ScreenChestCT.description:
## Feature Description  
The non-contrast chest CT screening capability leverages standard chest CT images to perform detection and quantification analysis across multiple organs and diseases in the human chest. Its primary features include:  
- Automatically measuring coronary artery calcium scores based on standard non-contrast chest CT scans.  
- Automatically detecting pulmonary nodules and outputting nodule volume, average grayscale value, and an AI-generated structured report.  
- Automatically segmenting pneumonia lesions within lung lobes and providing information such as lesion size and pneumonia type.  
- Detecting rib fractures and indicating the fracture type.  
- Identifying enlarged lymph nodes in non-contrast or contrast-enhanced chest CT scans, including mediastinal, hilar, and supraclavicular lymph nodes.  
- Assessing pancreatic cancer risk based on input non-contrast chest CT scans.  

> You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2). For inquiries regarding integration, API usage, or technical support for Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API visual AI capabilities, please join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform support team.  

## Common Scenarios  
After integrating the non-contrast chest CT screening capability with medical imaging applications, it provides radiologists and clinicians at hospitals, regional medical consortia, health screening centers, and third-party imaging centers with detection and quantification analysis of standard chest CT images.  

## Key Advantages  
Rich functionality—this is the first solution that enables multi-organ and multi-disease detection and quantification analysis through a single CT scan and one-time upload.  

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner of the page, click **Create Account** and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Activate the capability**: Ensure you have activated [Image Analysis Processing](https://vision.aliyun.com/imageprocess). If not, [activate it immediately](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_imageprocess_public_cn#/open).  
3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, assign the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission to the RAM user. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: You can debug this capability via [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/imageprocess/2020-03-20/ScreenChestCT?lang=JAVA), view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, and download the full project.  
5. **Development integration**: This capability supports invocation via software development kits (SDKs). Choose your preferred programming language for integration. For details, see [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
6. **Sample code**: For sample code in common programming languages to query asynchronous task results, see [Sample Code for Querying Asynchronous Task Results](~~607974~~).  

7. **Direct client invocation**: Common direct client invocation methods for this capability include:  
- [Direct invocation from web frontend](~~467779~~)  
- [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
- [Direct invocation from Android clients](~~467781~~)  
- [Direct invocation from iOS clients](~~467782~~)  

## Input Constraints  
- **Image format**: DICOM  
- **Image size**: No larger than 3 MB  
- **Image resolution**: Up to 512 × 512 pixels  
- **Number of frames**: Between 20 and 1600 frames, inclusive  
- **URLs must not contain Chinese characters**  

## Invocation Steps  
This capability is asynchronous and requires two steps:  
1. Invoke the `ScreenChestCT` API to submit a job. Upon a successful request, you will receive a job ID.  
2. Use the [`GetAsyncJobResult`](~~607824~~) API to query the result using the job ID. This returns the task execution status and result. If the task is still processing, wait a short while before querying again. Avoid resubmitting the same task while it is still being processed.  

## Billing Information  
For details on the metering method and pricing of non-contrast chest CT screening, see [Billing Introduction](~~202483~~).  

> The debugging API below is a paid service.

## Feature Description  
The Esophageal Cancer Detection capability evaluates the risk of esophageal cancer based on an input non-contrast chest CT scan. It can be applied to any non-contrast CT scan that covers the esophagus, such as non-contrast chest CT or non-contrast abdominal CT.

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).

## Common Scenarios  
Diagnostics screening: Supports input of non-contrast esophageal CT scans to assess esophageal cancer risk, and outputs both categorization results and lesion segmentation results.

## Key Advantages  

- **Esophageal Cancer Risk Assessment**: Provides three-class probabilities for normal esophageal tissue, esophageal cancer, and non-esophageal-cancer lesions. The class with the highest probability is taken as the final classification result.  
- **Lesion Visualization**: Outputs the volume and corresponding segmentation results (identified by NIFTI files) for normal esophageal tissue, esophageal cancer, and non-esophageal-cancer lesions.

## Input Restrictions  

- **Image format**: DICOM.  
- **Number of frames per request**: Minimum of 20 frames, maximum of 600 frames.  
- **URL length**: Must be between 20 and 600 characters and must not contain Chinese characters.

ScreenLC.title: Liver Cancer Detection
ScreenLC.description:
## Feature Description  
Input non-contrast CT scans covering the liver area, such as chest or abdominal non-contrast CT scans. The scans must be reconstructed using a mediastinal window. Thick-slice CT is preferred; thin-slice CT is also acceptable but may yield slightly lower accuracy. This feature detects multiple types of liver tumors, including:

- Lesion diagnosis results: hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), malignant tumors other than HCC, benign tumors other than cysts, cysts, and healthy tissue.

- Probabilities for each of the above lesion categories.

- For each detected lesion: category, volume, keyframe, RECIST long and short axis locations and lengths, malignancy probability, and the corresponding area (marked in a NIfTI file).

> - You can obtain online human assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- For questions regarding API integration, usage, or consultation about visual AI capabilities of Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner of the page, click **Create Account** and follow the instructions to complete registration.

2. **Activate the capability**: Ensure that you have activated [Image Analysis and Processing](https://vision.aliyun.com/imageprocess). If not, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_imageprocess_public_cn#/open).

3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure that you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, assign the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission to the RAM user. For details, see [RAM Authorization](~~145025~~).

4. **Online debugging (optional)**: You can debug this capability in real time using [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/imageprocess/2020-03-20/ScreenLC?spm=a2c4g.51704.0.i0), where you can view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.

5. **Integration steps**:
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).
   - In the documentation for your chosen language, locate and install the SDK package for the AI category "image analysis and processing (imageprocess)."
   - Modify the provided sample code as needed and invoke the API.

6. **Sample code**: For sample code in commonly used programming languages to query the results of asynchronous tasks, see [Sample Code for Querying Asynchronous Task Results](~~607974~~).

7. **Direct client invocation**: Common methods for direct client-side invocation include:
   - [Direct invocation from web frontend](~~467779~~)
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)

## Input Restrictions  
The **URLList** must contain between 20 and 600 images (i.e., each CT sequence must include at least 20 slices and at most 600 slices).

## Invocation Steps  
This capability is asynchronous and requires two steps:  
1. Call the ScreenLC API to submit a job. Upon successful request, you will receive a job ID.  
2. Call the [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~) API to query the result using the job ID. This returns the task execution status and result. If the task is still being processed, wait a short while before querying again. We recommend that you do not resubmit the same task while it is still running.

## Billing Information  
The liver cancer detection capability is currently in public preview and can be invoked free of charge.

SegmentLymphNode.description:
## Service Notice  
Due to product adjustments, the radiotherapy lymph node segmentation service will be migrated to DAMO Academy's [Dayi Zhiying official website](https://damomed.com). Starting from November 26, 2025, new users will no longer be able to activate or invoke this service. Existing users who have already activated the service may continue using it until November 26, 2026, after which the service will be delisted and will no longer support invocation by any user through the Visual Intelligence Open Platform. If you have questions regarding this migration, please visit DAMO Academy's [Dayi Zhiying official website](https://damomed.com) to contact the relevant personnel.

## Feature Description  
The radiotherapy lymph node segmentation feature performs lymph node station segmentation based on input non-contrast or contrast-enhanced chest CT scans with a specified target region. The target region is the chest (CHEST), and the segmentation result is provided as a mask in NIFTI format.

> - You can obtain live assistance via [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- For inquiries related to integrating Visual Intelligence API capabilities, using APIs, or troubleshooting issues on Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Common Scenarios  
Diagnostics screening: Supports input of non-contrast chest CT scans to assess colorectal cancer risk, outputting both categorization results and lesion segmentation results.

## Key Advantages  
- Colorectal cancer risk assessment: Outputs probabilities for three categories—normal colon, colorectal cancer, and non-colorectal cancer lesions—with the highest probability determining the final classification result.  
- Lesion visualization: Outputs the volume and corresponding segmentation results (identified by NIFTI files) for normal colon, colorectal cancer, and non-colorectal cancer lesions.

## Input Constraints  
The URLList length must be greater than 20 and less than 600 (i.e., each sequence must contain at least 20 slices and up to 600 slices). Each URL must be accessible via the HTTP protocol.

## Invocation Steps  
This feature is asynchronous and requires two steps to invoke:  
Step 1: Call the SegmentLymphNode API to submit a job. Upon successful request, you receive a job ID.  
Step 2: Call the [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~) API to query the result using the job ID, checking the job execution status and retrieving the result. If the job is still being processed, wait a short while before querying again. We recommend not resubmitting the same job while it is still running.

## Billing Information  
The radiotherapy lymph node segmentation feature is currently in public preview and can be invoked free of charge.
